name: v1.5.0 - Live YummyAnime Integration and Anixart Sync
body:
### Highlights in v1.5.0:
- **YummyAnime Live Catalog Integration**: Live catalog and search powered by YummyAnime API (api.yani.tv).
- **Anixart Backup Importer**: Full local storage sync for watch history and bookmarks on backup import.
- **Redesigned Profile Statistics**: Complete visual layout match with Anixart reference design including center Donut chart and statistics metrics.
